name: Edit and render static Product Page Content translations
user_goal: As a merchant (owner), translate the app's static, built-in product-page UI strings (form labels, buttons, validation/help text shown by the personalization widget) into another store language, so that buyers browsing the storefront in that language see localized UI text.

actors.permission_observed: user_id=266 (Linh explorer) successfully viewed, edited and saved config-translations via authenticated cookie session + x-xsrf-token + x-acting-user-id header. No cross-tenant/forbidden-token/other-role test performed — permission boundary itself is NOT confirmed, only that this specific owner account can perform the action.
Unauthenticated buyer viewing storefront product page sees the rendered translation with no login/auth required (public page render).

entry_points.path: Portal sidebar > Store Settings > Product Page Content (/product-page-content)
entry_points.precondition: role=owner, authenticated portal session, instance_id known (observed: 609)

entry_points.path: Storefront personalization widget (tee-campaign) on any product/campaign page, rendered as part of the initial HTML document for the buyer's active locale
entry_points.precondition: buyer's active locale != store default AND a translation override exists for that locale AND that field/key

capabilities.name: Inventory of translatable static fields (portal)
capabilities.description: Portal exposes ~110 static string fields across 21 named sections (Personalization form, Upload photo, Generate Image Buttons, Maps, Scrabble, Cart, etc.), each pre-filled with its English default value; some use {{PLACEHOLDER}} template variables.

capabilities.name: Language list sourced from store's published Shopify locales
capabilities.description: The 'Languages from <store>' combobox on this page is backed by GET /api/instances/{instanceId}/shop-locales, which returned exactly 2 entries (en/vi) matching the store's Shopify-published locales.

capabilities.name: Save translation override (sparse override over full English default)
capabilities.description: Save sends PUT /api/instances/{instanceId}/config-translations with the request body containing the FULL English default dataset (~110 fixed semantic keys, e.g. form_header_title) unchanged, plus the edited non-default locale as a SPARSE object with only the changed key(s). Response 200 echoes the structure back.

capabilities.name: Clear override normalizes to null (revert to default)
capabilities.description: Submitting an empty string for a previously-overridden field is persisted server-side as null (not empty string); on reload the field shows no override and falls back to the English default placeholder.

capabilities.name: Storefront propagation: immediate, server-side rendered
capabilities.description: A saved override for locale=vi appears in the personalization widget on the very first HTML document response for /vi/products/... — not via any client-side XHR/fetch call. The teeinblue campaign-config API (GET /api/merchant/campaigns/{productId}.json) still returns the English default for this field in both locales, even with an explicit Accept-Language header — the translated value is injected server-side at render time, outside client-observable network traffic.

state_transitions.from: field has no locale override (falls back to English default)
state_transitions.to: field has a saved override for the selected non-default locale
state_transitions.trigger: owner edits field value while a non-default locale is selected in the 'Languages from <store>' combobox, then clicks Save

state_transitions.from: field has a saved override for a locale
state_transitions.to: field has no override (null, falls back to English default) for that locale
state_transitions.trigger: owner clears the field to empty text while that locale is selected, then clicks Save
state_transitions.condition: server normalizes submitted empty string to null in the response

state_transitions.from: override saved on portal side only
state_transitions.to: override visible to buyers on storefront in that locale
state_transitions.trigger: buyer requests the product page under a URL path prefixed with the overridden locale (e.g. /vi/products/...)
state_transitions.condition: observed as IMMEDIATE on next page load in this run (single sample, no CDN-cache/propagation-delay scenario tested)

observed_behavior: Selecting a different locale in the 'Languages from <store>' combobox does NOT trigger any additional network request and does NOT change the portal's own UI display language (sidebar/heading/buttons stay English) — it only changes which locale's content is shown/edited in the form. (See also language-locale-switcher profile, capability 'portal edit-context locale selector', KB-004.)

GET /api/merchant/campaigns/{productId}.json response is byte-identical for this field between locale=en and locale=vi requests, including with Accept-Language header explicitly varied — confirms the override is delivered by a mechanism other than this endpoint.
permissions: Only role=owner (user_id=266) was exercised for the save action in this run — no PERMISSION/cross-tenant test (TIB_USER_B, TIB_FORBIDDEN_TOKEN) was performed against PUT /api/instances/{instanceId}/config-translations. Whether the backend validates instance_id ownership against session vs. trusting the path param is unverified.

api: GET /api/merchant/campaigns/{productId}.json — negative evidence only, does not carry the override
data: config-translations dataset: full 'en' default set + sparse per-locale override object, keyed by fixed semantic keys (e.g. form_header_title)

dependencies: Depends on the store's published Shopify locale list (shop-locales, KB-003) shared with language-locale-switcher profile.
Depends on language-locale-switcher profile's 'portal edit-context locale selector' capability to determine which locale a save targets.

Storefront rendering depends on an unmapped server-side injection mechanism (see unknown_areas) that is architecturally upstream of both this profile and the dynamic-translations profile's storefront propagation question (CONFLICT-001) — the two profiles' storefront delivery mechanisms are NOT confirmed to be the same code path, only that both are observed to bypass the client-visible campaign-config API.
risks: The save request always re-sends the full English default dataset (~110 keys) alongside the sparse override (KB-005) — behavior under concurrent edits/saves by two sessions, or partial/stale default sets, is unverified (single-sample observation).

unknown_areas.question: What is the exact server-side mechanism (app embed / theme extension / backend route) that resolves the buyer's locale and injects the Product Page Content translation into the raw HTML document for /vi/products/...?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Without this, defect triage for 'translation not showing on storefront' cannot distinguish a caching/propagation-delay issue from a locale-resolution bug; also blocks confirming whether this same mechanism could plausibly deliver Dynamic Translations too (relevant to CONFLICT-001 in the dynamic-translations profile).

unknown_areas.question: What GET endpoint (if any) loads existing config-translations overrides when /product-page-content is first opened?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Only the SAVE call was captured; regression testing of 'existing overrides display correctly on page load' needs this endpoint identified to assert against, not just UI screenshots.

unknown_areas.question: Does storefront propagation stay IMMEDIATE under real CDN caching (this run only used fresh, uncached Playwright browser contexts)?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: A merchant-facing 'why isn't my translation showing yet' support case needs to know whether any wait/cache-purge step is ever required.

profile_relationships.note: Uses the portal edit-context locale selector to determine save target locale, and the storefront locale switcher to determine which locale's override a buyer sees.

Both are sub-features of the Translation object but use materially different storage/API models (KB-019) and have DIFFERENT confirmed storefront propagation outcomes — do not assume parity between them.

coverage_matrix.state: load existing overrides on page open
